The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 11. Generic Shelf Life: The Product/Spare parts to be supplied as part of the services must have minimum 10 Years Shelf Life. On the date of supply, minimum 7 Years usable shelf life should be available / balance. 12. Generic

Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 22. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.

23. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 24. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 25. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The bidder to comply with the following conditions. 1. Bidder to provide delivery of the stores / spares at specified locations within the delivery period. 2. The item (in partial or whole) is liable to be rejected if not found confirmi ng to requisite quality and specifications. 3. Payment of GST/ any Govt dues will be the sole responsibility of the bidde r. Confirmation with regard to the same is mandatory. 4. Payment schedule. The payment will only be made on basis of rec eipt and acceptance of 100% stores by the Board of Officers as per specification and as per terms and conditions of contract. 5. The spares / items should be confirming to the specification/ relevant IS a nd ISI Marked. The spares (in partial or whole) is liable to be rejected if not foun d confirming to requisite quality and specifications. Bidder to replace the defecti ve / unsuitable spares/ parts within 7 days of raising request for the same from Buyer. 6. Compensation. In event of bidder not being able to execute the contr act within given time, a compensation of 0.5% of the contract amount will be le vied per week subject to max of 10% of the of contract amount. 7. Bidder shall provide warranty against manufacturing defects for a period of 24 months from the date of supply. 8. Bidder should have experience of successful supply and delivery of stores similar product for last three consecutive financial years to any defence establis hment in remote mountainous area. 9. Litigation/ Arbitration. The timely supply of spares by the supplier a s per the supply order is of para mount importance. Hence, no time extension of any kind shall be granted under any circumstances (except under force majeure i.e, due to natural or national calamities or any other extreme circumstances). T he supply order is liable to be cancelled in case of non-supply of stores within c ompletion period. No litigation or arbitration under any circumstances at any sta ge shall be applicable. If there are varying or conflicting provision made in any o f the documents forming part of the supply order, the BUYER shall be the sole d eciding authority with regard to the intention and his decision shall be final and binding. Supplier is responsible to go through the provisions and bring out discr epancy, if any.

10. Each and every item should adhere to latest ISI specification, relevant IS, OEM. Any specific brand or make (not specified above) may be accepted subjec t to approval of BUYER. 11. Only relevant documents be uploaded as per the criteria mentioned. Uplo ading of irrelevant and (or) incorrect information/ documents may lead to rejecti on of technical bid. No representation whatsoever will be entertained thereafter . 12. Bidder should submit banker’s solvency certificate (equal or more than a mount of bid value). 13. Performance of bidder in Command and with any Govt/ PSUs department shall be assessed during evaluation. Bidder to upload the latest Work Load Retu rn (WLR). 14. Bidder to provide any accessories/ tools/ equipment which deems to be n ecessary as per buyer discretion for site modification/ joining/ fabricating without any extra cost to Govt. 15. In case of any ambiguity with respect to understating/ interpretation of te chnical specification/ store list/ drawings etc, decision of buyer will be final and binding. 16. Demurrage charges. In case the rejected items are not lifted by th e firm within 48 hrs, the demurrage charges at the rate of 0.5% of total contract value will be charged per day. In case the items are not lifted within a month, t he same will be destroyed by the station board of officers and no claim will be a dmitted. 17. Inspection of stores as below:- (a) The buyer has a right to inspect goods in reasonable manner and within reasonable time at any reasonable place as indicated in contract. (b) An independent inspection will be carried out by independent Boar d of Officers of buyer organization. (c) Board of Officers shall have the right to put all the stores or materi als forming part of the same or any part thereof to such tests as he may lik e fit and proper as per QAP/ governing specification. The seller shall not be entitled to object on any ground whatsoever to the method of testing adopte d by the inspecting officer. (d) Unless otherwise provided for in the contract, the quantity of the s tores or material expended in test will be borne by seller. (e) Inspecting officer is the final authority to certify performance/ acc ept the consignment. The inspecting officer’s decision as regards as regards t he rejection shall be final and binding on the seller. 18. The product used for providing service offered as mentioned in the bid sh

ould conform to criteria of Govt policy in vogue for ultimate beneficiary and ToT from land border sharing countries. The bids of bidder offering service having pr oducts in violation to the policy shall be out rightly rejected without assigning a ny reasons for whatsoever. 19. Official Secret Act. The contractors attention is invited to Indian O fficial Secret Act 1923 (xxx of 1923) particularly Sec 5 of thereof. The contractor s shall be bound by the provision of this Act. 20. The material (in partial or whole) is liable to be rejected if not found confo rming to requisite quality and specs. Bidder to provide one sample of each item for approval of buyer. Branded makes duly OEM verified shall be accepted. 21. Attendance in Pre-bid meeting: It is mandatory to attend pre-bid meeting as the work is of specific nature and is required to be undertaken in ha rsh terrain and weather conditions. Since, the work to be undertaken in restrict ed area it is important for the vendor to understand the nuances of security cle arances and necessary protocols which are to be adhered while delivering store s/execution of the jobs. In case of failure to attend pre-bid meeting on the due date by bidder/Authorise representative, Accepting Officer may at his sole discr etion, reserves the right of disqualifying the bidder during the Technical Bid eva luation. 22. Repeat Order Clause: The Contract will have a repeat order clause, wherein the buyer can order upto 50% quantity of the items under the present contract within the six months from the date of supply/successful compl etion of this contract. The cost, terms & condition remaining the same. The bidder is to confirm acceptance of this clause. It will be entirely at the discretio n of the buyer to place the repeat order or not. 23. Vendor to submit OEM authorization certificate (where applicable)/ Vetted drawing from NIT/IIT/ Govt Engg College during TEC Stage only as per specificati ons contained in TS. In case of failure to so, Accepting Officer may at his sole di scretion, reserves the right of disqualifying the bidder during the Technical Bid e valuation. 24. Details missing/ Discrepancy if any (including tools, spares, accessories, mismatch in dimension/ quantity of structural members and accessories like, do ors, windows, electrical and sanitary fittings etc.) required for execution of job w ill be assumed to be provided by the supplier as per good engineering practice, and will be approved by inspection team of consignee/ Engineer In-charge/ Acce pting Officer without any additional cost. 25. All material required shall comply with the specifications provided in TS or relevant Bureau of Indian Standard Specification, if found missing is TS with due approval of accepting office. 26. Minor addition/ deletion /changes will be at the direction of Engr-in-charge executing the work and will be carried out without any additional cost at the time of execut ion. 27. Confirmation to the above conditions is mandatory during the Tech evalu ation. 28. Proof for Past Performance. For fulfilling the Past Performance crite ria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for me eting the experience criteria: (a) CRAC Copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that servic

e/supplies against the invoices have been executed. (b) Past Performance Certificate issued by the co ncerned User Unit of any PSU or Government Agency. The certificate must cont ain complete details of the contract, including the Contract/Work Order Number and Date, Scope of Work, Contract Value, Contract Period, details of goods/servi ces supplied or work executed, and actual completion status, duly signed and st amped by the authorized official of the concerned PSU/Government Agency. . 26. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 27. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 28. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 29. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 7 days time limit. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer. 30. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c.
